summary.en: Adani Group uses Vertex AI Search and Vector Search to power semantic search across its internal a-connect newsletter.
summary.zh: Adani Group 運用 Vertex AI Search 與 Vector Search，讓員工能以語意理解搜尋 a-connect 內部通訊平台的文章、圖片與影片。

overview.en: Adani Group, one of India's largest multinational conglomerates, transformed its internal a-connect newsletter platform using Vertex AI Search and Vector Search. The AI-powered system indexes multimodal content — including text, images, and video — enabling employees to search using semantic understanding rather than keyword matching. BigQuery handles large-scale data analytics and Cloud Functions power backend services.
overview.zh: Adani Group 是印度最大的跨國企業集團之一，藉由 Vertex AI Search 與 Vector Search 改造 a-connect 內部通訊平台。新系統支援多模態內容索引（文字、圖片、影片），讓員工透過語意搜尋快速找到所需資訊，後端由 BigQuery 與 Cloud Functions 支援。

en: Semantic search across text, images, and videos replaces keyword-only search in the a-connect newsletter platform.
Average search query time significantly reduced, with increased successful search rates and user engagement.
Automatic summarizations and citations surface relevant content without requiring manual review.
BigQuery, Cloud Functions, and Dialogflow integrated with Vertex AI for a scalable, unified platform.
zh: a-connect 平台以語意搜尋取代傳統關鍵字搜尋，支援文字、圖片與影片多模態內容。
平均查詢時間顯著縮短，搜尋成功率與用戶參與度提升。
AI 自動生成摘要並附上引用來源，免去人工審閱。
整合 BigQuery、Cloud Functions 與 Dialogflow，打造可擴展的統一平台。

summary.en: AES cut energy safety audit costs by 99% and reduced audit time from 14 days to one hour using gen AI agents.
summary.zh: AES 以 Vertex AI 與 Anthropic Claude 建構 AI 代理，將能源安全稽核成本降低 99%，稽核時間從 14 天縮至 1 小時。

overview.en: AES, a global energy company, built gen AI agents using Vertex AI and Anthropic's Claude models to automate its extensive safety audit program — covering over 1,500 audits annually across power generation sites. The agents review compliance documentation, generate audit reports, and flag issues, dramatically reducing both cost and time while improving accuracy. After conducting more than 50 agent audits, results were delivered 99.7% faster.
overview.zh: AES 是一家全球能源公司，每年執行逾 1,500 次安全管理稽核。透過在 Vertex AI 上運行 Anthropic Claude 模型所建構的 AI 代理，自動審閱合規文件、生成稽核報告並標記問題。超過 50 次代理稽核後，結果呈現速度提升 99.7%，精準度也同步提升。

en: 99% reduction in audit costs per audit after deploying gen AI agents on Vertex AI.
Audit report generation time reduced from approximately 14 days to about 1 hour — a 99.7% time reduction.
Audit accuracy improved by 10–20% compared to manual processes.
Claude models on Vertex AI selected for ability to handle large API call volumes and synchronize agents for complex tasks.
zh: 每次稽核成本降低 99%。
稽核報告生成時間從約 14 天縮短至約 1 小時，速度提升 99.7%。
稽核精準度較人工流程提升 10–20%。
選用 Vertex AI 上的 Claude 模型，原因在於其能處理大量 API 呼叫並協調複雜任務中的多個代理。

summary.en: Asia Digital Engineering doubled development lifecycle speed using Gemini, Document AI, and Vertex AI for MRO digital operations.
summary.zh: Asia Digital Engineering 結合 Gemini、Document AI 與 Vertex AI，將開發生命週期速度提升一倍，大幅加速航空 MRO 數據處理。

overview.en: Asia Digital Engineering (ADE), a leading aircraft Maintenance, Repair, and Overhaul provider born from Malaysia AirAsia's engineering department during COVID-19, adopted Gemini, Document AI, and Vertex AI to enhance digital operations. The implementation doubled development lifecycle speed through containerization and significantly accelerated data processing across large datasets. BigQuery and Looker Studio power analytics and dashboards across the organization.
overview.zh: Asia Digital Engineering（ADE）源自馬來西亞 AirAsia 工程部門，是亞太地區領先的飛機維修、修理與翻修（MRO）服務商。導入 Gemini、Document AI 與 Vertex AI 後，開發生命週期速度提升一倍，大型資料集的處理效率顯著提升。BigQuery 與 Looker Studio 支援全公司的分析與儀表板需求。

en: Development lifecycle speed doubled through containerization and AI-assisted workflows.
Large dataset analysis significantly accelerated, enabling faster operational decisions.
Gemini and Document AI used for sophisticated ML tasks and document processing in MRO contexts.
Vertex AI Workbench supports the team's ML development and job execution.
zh: 透過容器化與 AI 輔助工作流，開發生命週期速度提升一倍。
大型資料集分析速度顯著提升，加快運營決策效率。
在 MRO 場景中，Gemini 與 Document AI 用於複雜機器學習任務與文件處理。
Vertex AI Workbench 支援團隊的機器學習開發與任務執行。

summary.en: Bayer Crop Science researchers use data science agents to eliminate manual data management and focus on agricultural innovation.
summary.zh: Bayer Crop Science 研究人員透過資料科學代理消除手動資料管理，專注推動農業永續創新。

overview.en: Bayer Crop Science researchers are using gen AI-powered data science agents to automate manual data management and analytics workflows. By removing the burden of repetitive data tasks, researchers can redirect their time and expertise toward pioneering agricultural innovations that support a more sustainable and productive future for food production.
overview.zh: Bayer Crop Science 的研究人員透過 AI 驅動的資料科學代理，自動化手動資料管理與分析工作流程。消除重複性資料作業後，研究人員能將精力投注於開創性農業創新，為糧食生產的永續未來做出貢獻。

en: Data science agents automate manual data management tasks for agricultural researchers.
Researchers freed from repetitive analytics to focus on sustainable agricultural innovation.
Part of Bayer's broader adoption of generative AI across crop science R&D.
zh: 資料科學代理自動化農業研究人員的手動資料管理任務。
研究人員從重複性分析工作中解放，得以專注於農業永續創新。
屬於 Bayer 在農業科學研發領域更廣泛導入生成式 AI 的一部分。

summary.en: Bosch integrates Gemini Enterprise into its AskBosch internal platform, enabling employees to deploy their own AI agents.
summary.zh: Bosch 將 Gemini Enterprise 整合至內部 AskBosch 平台，讓全公司員工皆可自行部署 AI 代理。

overview.en: Bosch is scaling innovation from power tools to emergency safety by integrating Gemini Enterprise into AskBosch, its internal platform for accelerating AI adoption. The platform enables employees across the organization to deploy their own AI agents, extending AI capabilities from centralized IT teams to individual business units. AskBosch's integration of Gemini Enterprise represents a key step in Bosch's enterprise-wide AI democratization strategy.
overview.zh: Bosch 將 Gemini Enterprise 整合至內部 AI 加速平台 AskBosch，讓全公司員工得以自行部署 AI 代理，從集中式 IT 團隊延伸至各業務單位。這是 Bosch 推動全企業 AI 民主化策略的關鍵一步，應用範圍橫跨電動工具至緊急安全系統。

en: Gemini Enterprise integrated into AskBosch, Bosch's internal AI acceleration platform.
Employees across all divisions can deploy their own specialized AI agents without deep technical expertise.
Bosch extends AI adoption from power tools and consumer products to safety-critical applications.
Part of Bosch's broader partnership with Google Cloud announced at Cloud Next 2026.
zh: Gemini Enterprise 整合至 Bosch 內部 AI 加速平台 AskBosch。
各部門員工無需深厚技術背景即可部署專屬 AI 代理。
AI 應用範疇從電動工具、消費品延伸至安全關鍵系統。
屬於 Bosch 與 Google Cloud 在 Cloud Next 2026 宣布的更廣泛合作夥伴關係。

summary.en: Bynry's SMART360 is an AI-driven SaaS platform for small and mid-sized utilities, featured as a gen AI use case in Google Cloud's industry overview.
summary.zh: Bynry 的 SMART360 是針對中小型公用事業公司的 AI 驅動 SaaS 平台，被 Google Cloud 列為產業生成式 AI 應用案例。

overview.en: Bynry's SMART360 is an AI-driven SaaS utility management platform that empowers small and mid-sized water, electricity, and gas utilities to digitize critical workflows — including billing, metering, customer relationship management, and infrastructure monitoring. Bynry is featured in Google Cloud's generative AI use case collection. Note: SMART360's infrastructure runs on AWS per Bynry's own documentation.
overview.zh: Bynry 的 SMART360 是一套 AI 驅動的 SaaS 公用事業管理平台，協助中小型水、電、氣業者數位化關鍵工作流程，包括計費、計量、客戶關係管理與基礎設施監控。Bynry 被 Google Cloud 收錄於生成式 AI 應用案例集中。注意：依據 Bynry 自身文件，SMART360 的基礎設施運行於 AWS 上。

en: SMART360 serves small and mid-sized water, electric, and gas utilities with a unified cloud-native SaaS platform.
Platform covers billing, metering, CRM, field service, and infrastructure monitoring workflows.
Featured in Google Cloud gen AI use case collection as a utility management example.
zh: SMART360 為中小型水、電、氣公用事業提供統一的雲端原生 SaaS 平台。
平台涵蓋計費、計量、CRM、現場服務與基礎設施監控工作流程。
被 Google Cloud 收錄為公用事業管理領域的生成式 AI 應用案例。

summary.en: Copel built a Gemini Pro 1.5 AI agent that lets employees query its SAP ERP system using natural language.
summary.zh: 巴西電力公司 Copel 以 Gemini Pro 1.5 建構 AI 代理，讓員工用自然語言查詢 SAP ERP 系統數據。

overview.en: Copel, a major Brazilian electric utility company, developed an AI agent powered by Gemini Pro 1.5 that connects to its on-premises SAP ERP system. Employees can ask questions in natural language and receive data-driven answers without navigating complex ERP interfaces or manual exports to Excel. The solution uses Vertex AI, Open Data QnA, and BigQuery as core components.
overview.zh: 巴西主要電力公司 Copel 建構了一套由 Gemini Pro 1.5 驅動的 AI 代理，直接對接其本地 SAP ERP 系統。員工可用自然語言提問並獲得數據驅動的回答，無需操作複雜的 ERP 介面或手動匯出 Excel。核心架構包括 Vertex AI、Open Data QnA 與 BigQuery。

en: Natural language interface allows employees to query SAP ERP data without technical expertise.
Replaces manual processes and RPA tools, reducing inconsistencies in financial and operational data.
Generative AI in accounts payable brings agility and rapid resolution of complex financial issues.
Built on Vertex AI, Open Data QnA, and BigQuery for a scalable, enterprise-grade solution.
zh: 自然語言介面讓員工無需技術背景即可查詢 SAP ERP 數據。
取代手動流程與 RPA 工具，減少財務與運營數據的不一致性。
應付帳款中的生成式 AI 提升了靈活性，快速解決複雜財務問題。
建構於 Vertex AI、Open Data QnA 與 BigQuery，打造企業級可擴展解決方案。

summary.en: Danfoss automated 80% of email-based B2B orders with AI agents on Google Cloud, cutting response time from 42 hours to near real-time.
summary.zh: Danfoss 在 Google Cloud 上部署 AI 代理，自動化 80% 的電子郵件訂單處理，客戶回應時間從 42 小時縮短至近即時。

overview.en: Danfoss, a global manufacturer operating in over 100 countries, partnered with Go Autonomous — discovered via Google Marketplace — to deploy AI agents on Google Cloud for email-based order processing. The autonomous commerce platform reads incoming orders, validates data against SAP, and prepares orders for processing. It automated 80% of transactional decisions, consolidated five legacy systems into one interface, and cut customer response time from 42 hours to under one minute.
overview.zh: 丹麥全球製造商 Danfoss 透過 Google Marketplace 找到 Go Autonomous，在 Google Cloud 上部署 AI 代理處理電子郵件訂單。平台自動讀取訂單、對比 SAP 驗證數據並準備處理，自動化了 80% 的交易決策，將五個遺留系統整合為單一介面，客戶回應時間從 42 小時縮短至 1 分鐘以內。

en: 80% of transactional email orders processed autonomously without human escalation.
Customer response time reduced from 42 hours to under 1 minute — orders processed across 26 countries.
Five separate systems consolidated into a single interface.
Go Autonomous platform runs on Google Cloud using Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE) for reliability and scale.
zh: 80% 的電子郵件訂單可在無需人工介入的情況下自動處理。
客戶回應時間從 42 小時縮短至 1 分鐘以內，覆蓋 26 個國家。
五套獨立系統整合為單一介面。
Go Autonomous 平台在 Google Cloud 上運行，以 Google Kubernetes Engine（GKE）確保可靠性與可擴展性。

summary.en: Enpal reduced solar panel quote generation time by 87.5% — from 120 minutes to 15 minutes — using AI automation with Google Cloud.
summary.zh: Enpal 與 Google Cloud 合作夥伴 dida 合作，以 AI 自動化太陽能板報價流程，所需時間從 120 分鐘縮短至 15 分鐘，降幅達 87.5%。

overview.en: Enpal, a German solar energy company, worked with Google Cloud partner dida to automate its solar panel sales quoting process. The AI solution uses Google Maps Platform API to gather rooftop images, analyzes roof size and tile count, estimates the number of panels required, and generates accurate sales quotes. The system reduced quote generation from 120 minutes to 15 minutes, achieving approximately 93% accuracy in panel estimations.
overview.zh: 德國太陽能公司 Enpal 與 Google Cloud 合作夥伴 dida 攜手，自動化太陽能板銷售報價流程。AI 解決方案透過 Google Maps Platform API 取得屋頂影像，分析屋頂尺寸與磚瓦數量，估算所需面板數並生成準確報價，太陽能板估算精準度約達 93%。

en: Quote generation time reduced 87.5%, from 120 minutes to 15 minutes per quote.
Approximately 93% accuracy achieved in solar panel estimations.
From 13 initial users at launch to 150 Enpal employees saving time with the solution.
Google Maps Platform API used to collect rooftop imagery; Cloud Storage manages images with cost-efficient storage transitions.
zh: 報價生成時間縮短 87.5%，從 120 分鐘降至 15 分鐘。
太陽能板估算精準度約達 93%。
使用者從初始 13 人成長至 150 名 Enpal 員工，每人皆節省大量時間。
以 Google Maps Platform API 收集屋頂影像；Cloud Storage 以自動存儲類別轉換管理影像並控制成本。

summary.en: GE Appliances deployed 800+ Gemini Enterprise AI agents across manufacturing, quality control, and supply chain operations.
summary.zh: GE Appliances 在製造、品質控制與供應鏈運營中部署逾 800 個 Gemini Enterprise AI 代理，推動工廠數位化轉型。

overview.en: GE Appliances has deployed more than 800 AI agents powered by Google Cloud's Gemini Enterprise across its manufacturing, logistics, and supply chain operations. The system is embedded in its Brilliant Factory manufacturing data platform, enabling real-time, data-driven decision-making on the factory floor. Employees can query production data conversationally, identify root causes faster, and monitor equipment health, shifting from reactive to proactive operations management.
overview.zh: GE Appliances 在製造、物流與供應鏈中部署超過 800 個由 Google Cloud Gemini Enterprise 驅動的 AI 代理，整合至「Brilliant Factory」製造數據平台，實現工廠現場的即時數據驅動決策。員工可以對話方式查詢生產數據、更快速識別根本原因並監控設備健康狀態，從被動問題解決轉向主動運營管理。

en: 800+ AI agents deployed across manufacturing, logistics, and supply chain operations.
Quality Insights AI tool enhances product design and accelerates improvement across customer logistics.
Automated Supplier Collaboration Agent led to a 25% reduction in backorders.
AI agents analyze shift data in minutes rather than hours, enabling real-time root cause identification.
zh: 跨製造、物流與供應鏈部署逾 800 個 AI 代理。
Quality Insights AI 工具提升產品設計品質，加速客戶物流改善。
自動化供應商協作代理使缺貨率降低 25%。
AI 代理可在數分鐘（而非數小時）內分析班次數據，實現即時根本原因識別。

summary.zh: Honeywell 將 Gemini 整合至樓宇自動化產品，並運用 AI 代理協助工程師管理產品生命週期。

overview.en: Honeywell, a nearly 120-year-old manufacturing company, partnered with Google Cloud to incorporate Gemini into its building automation products and leverage AI agents for product lifecycle management. The collaboration, announced in October 2024, connects AI agents with Honeywell Forge's IoT platform and Gemini on Vertex AI to automate repetitive engineering tasks, shorten project cycles, and provide real-time insights from multimodal industrial data.
overview.zh: 擁有近 120 年歷史的製造企業 Honeywell，與 Google Cloud 合作，將 Gemini 整合至樓宇自動化產品，並透過 AI 代理輔助產品生命週期管理。此合作於 2024 年 10 月宣布，將 Honeywell Forge IoT 平台與 Vertex AI 上的 Gemini 串連，自動化重複性工程任務、縮短專案週期，並從多模態工業數據中獲取即時洞察。

en: Gemini incorporated into Honeywell's building automation products for intelligent building management.
AI agents review product designs against all previous versions to troubleshoot issues and accelerate engineering.
Honeywell Forge IoT platform connected to Gemini on Vertex AI for real-time multimodal data insights.
AI-powered agents designed to automate repetitive tasks and shorten product development project cycles.
zh: Gemini 整合至 Honeywell 樓宇自動化產品，實現智慧樓宇管理。
AI 代理對比所有歷史版本審查產品設計，協助排查問題並加速工程流程。
Honeywell Forge IoT 平台與 Vertex AI 上的 Gemini 連結，提供即時多模態數據洞察。
AI 代理自動化重複性任務，縮短產品開發專案週期。

summary.zh: Honeywell 以百萬份產品規格訓練 AI，為數位孿生樓宇管理生成數十億條洞察。

overview.en: Honeywell trains digital twins on a dataset of one million product specifications to generate billions of insights for building management. This approach enables intelligent, data-driven operation of large building portfolios, supporting energy efficiency, maintenance planning, and facility management at scale through AI-powered digital twin technology.

en: Digital twins trained on over one million product specifications to generate building management insights.
Billions of insights generated to support intelligent, data-driven building operations.
Extends Honeywell's Google Cloud AI partnership across building automation and facilities management.

生成數十億條洞察，支援智慧數據驅動的樓宇運營。
延伸 Honeywell 與 Google Cloud 的 AI 合作，涵蓋樓宇自動化與設施管理。

summary.en: Hydro Ottawa uses Gemini for Google Workspace to automate daily employee tasks and drive productivity across the electricity provider.
summary.zh: 加拿大電力公司 Hydro Ottawa 使用 Gemini for Google Workspace，協助員工自動化日常任務，提升組織生產力。

overview.en: Hydro Ottawa, the electricity provider for Canada's capital, adopted Gemini for Google Workspace to help employees automate daily tasks and collaborate more efficiently. The Gemini pilot started with 50 users and quickly expanded to over 100 as team members discovered productivity benefits including email summarization, document search, and content drafting. The initiative supports Hydro Ottawa's broader energy transition strategy.
overview.zh: 加拿大首都的電力供應商 Hydro Ottawa 導入 Gemini for Google Workspace，協助員工自動化日常任務並提升協作效率。試行計畫從 50 名用戶開始，隨著員工體驗到電子郵件摘要、文件搜尋和內容起草等生產力效益後，迅速擴展至逾 100 人，也支援 Hydro Ottawa 的能源轉型策略。

en: Gemini pilot expanded from 50 to 100+ users as productivity benefits became apparent.
Employees use Gemini in Workspace side panels for email summarization, document search, and content drafting.
Initiative supports Hydro Ottawa's strategic goals for the energy sector transition.
Results in better and more cost-effective services for customers served by the utility.
zh: Gemini 試行計畫在生產力效益顯現後從 50 人擴展至逾 100 人。
員工透過 Workspace 側欄使用 Gemini 進行電子郵件摘要、文件搜尋及內容起草。
計畫支援 Hydro Ottawa 在能源轉型領域的策略目標。
為客戶帶來更好、更具成本效益的服務。

summary.en: Léon Grosse uses Gemini in Google Workspace to automate document summarization, data analysis, and content drafting across 2,300 employees.
summary.zh: 建築業領導者 Léon Grosse 在 Google Workspace 中使用 Gemini，讓 2,300 名員工自動化文件摘要、數據分析與內容起草工作。

overview.en: Léon Grosse, a French construction industry leader with 2,300 employees across 30+ offices and 200 building sites, uses Gemini in Google Workspace to automate complex tasks including document summarization, data analysis, and content drafting. summary.en: Suzano developed VagaLúmen — a Gemini Pro AI agent translating natural language into SQL — achieving a 95% reduction in SAP data query time.

overview.en: Suzano, the world's largest pulp manufacturer, worked with Google Cloud and Sauter to develop VagaLúmen — an AI platform powered by Gemini Pro that uses the Cortex Framework to translate natural language questions into SQL queries against SAP Materials data on BigQuery. Since going live in May 2024, the platform has democratized data access for 50,000 employees, reducing query time for materials data from 2 minutes to just 8 seconds.

en: 95% reduction in query time for SAP Materials data — from 2 minutes to 8 seconds.
50,000 employees enabled to query SAP data using natural language without technical SQL knowledge.
VagaLúmen reached 4,000 accesses and 473 unique users since Go Live in May 2024.
Built on Gemini Pro, Cortex Framework, and BigQuery as part of Google Cloud's SAP integration.
zh: SAP 材料數據查詢時間減少 95%——從 2 分鐘縮短至 8 秒。

overview.en: Tata Steel partnered with Google Cloud to deploy a unified agentic AI strategy across its global operations. In just nine months, the company deployed over 300 specialized AI agents spanning operations, finance, HR, and shop floor environments using Zen AI — a low-code platform built on Google Cloud's Agent Development Kit — and BigQuery. The Tata Steel Digital Assistant (TDA) resolves over 70% of HR helpdesk queries, and a Safety EyeQ system monitors live video feeds for safety violations.

summary.en: Zoppas Industries also uses Gemini to support HR analysis tasks and enhance decision-making with secure AI tools.
summary.zh: Zoppas Industries 同時以 Gemini 支援人力資源分析任務，在維持全球安全協議的前提下提升決策品質。

overview.en: Beyond meeting automation, Zoppas Industries extends its use of Gemini to support HR analysis tasks and enhance organizational decision-making. The generative AI tools help HR and management teams work more efficiently by surfacing insights from workforce data, while maintaining premium security protocols across all global teams.
overview.zh: 在會議自動化之外，Zoppas Industries 進一步將 Gemini 應用於支援人力資源分析任務與強化組織決策。生成式 AI 工具協助人力資源與管理團隊從員工數據中提取洞察，同時在所有全球團隊中維持高標準的安全協議。

en: Gemini supports HR analysis tasks, surfacing insights from workforce data for better decision-making.
Generative AI helps HR and management teams work more efficiently.
Premium security protocols maintained across all global teams while using AI tools.
Extends Zoppas Industries' Gemini adoption from productivity automation to people analytics.
zh: Gemini 支援人力資源分析任務，從員工數據中提取洞察，提升決策品質。
生成式 AI 協助人力資源與管理團隊提升工作效率。
使用 AI 工具的同時，在所有全球團隊中維持高標準安全協議。
將 Zoppas Industries 的 Gemini 應用從生產力自動化延伸至人員分析。
